1.consolidated_definition: Funda de catre: Sustantivo que designa la funda del catre, generalmente de lona blanca, aprovechada de un uso anterior de sacos para contener harina.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Cot bed cover: Noun referring to the cover of a cot, typically made of white canvas, repurposed from a previous use as sacks for containing flour.
